name: Meshy AI
description: Connect Meshy AI and create in 3D right in the chat: generate 3D models from text or pictures, check progress and your credit balance anytime, and download model files in one click.

description_en: Connect Meshy AI and create in 3D right in the chat: generate 3D models from text or pictures, check progress and your credit balance anytime, and download model files in one click.
